summary: Diff adds a CutoffsRecord type and two query methods to inspect cutoffs, but cutoffs are not stored in stable state (so they won’t persist across upgrades). The change also introduces an extra backend module (migration.mo) despite the constraint to keep all backend logic in backend/main.mo, and appears to modify predictor logic beyond the requested scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Cutoff records must be stored in stable state so they survive canister upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: In backend/main.mo, cutoffs is defined as an immutable in-memory value (`let cutoffs = List.empty<CutoffsRecord>()`) and is not declared as a `stable` variable nor persisted via stable structures; no evidence of upgrade-safe persistence in main.mo.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing `predictAdmission` method continues to compile and work as before (no predictor logic changes in this step).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows `predictAdmission` implementing specific Safe/Probable/Dream logic based on `approxRank`. Without seeing the prior implementation, this indicates predictor logic changes were made in this step, which violates the stated acceptance criterion/non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a separate backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) and wired main.mo to use `(with migration = Migration.run)`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints state the backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in `backend/main.mo`. Adding `backend/migration.mo` introduces additional backend logic outside main.mo.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a `getPredictions` update-style method stub unrelated to cutoffs storage/accessors.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-7/REQ-8 only request persistent cutoffs storage plus two query accessors (count and bounded range). No additional prediction API was requested for this step.
Non-goals explicitly include not updating predictor logic to use cutoffs or implementing Safe/Probable/Dream classification based on cutoff ranks; and AC says no predictor logic changes in this step.
